name: newgui
description: Cross-platform C++ UI toolkit inspired by the Haiku Interface Kit

tests.description: Unit tests and the test kit (ngui_testkit): GoogleTest, and libpng for the PNG files of image snapshots

skia.description: Skia backend (CPU raster): PNG for screenshots, FreeType for typefaces made from the text subsystem's font files (specification 13.4); no GPU, no fontconfig (finding fonts is the text subsystem's job), no HarfBuzz/ICU (shaping too). FreeType is listed directly to switch off its default features (brotli, bzip2): vcpkg honours default-features false of a transitive dependency only if the manifest says so too.

text.description: The text subsystem (ngui_text): HarfBuzz for shaping and metrics, with its own OpenType functions; libunibreak for line, word and grapheme boundaries (UAX #14 and #29); FreeType comes with the search for system fonts.

svg.description: Vector icons (ngui_svg): lunasvg renders SVG icons into bitmaps, with its rasterizer plutovg; independent of the drawing backend.

sdl3.description: The SDL3 platform (ngui_sdl3): windows, events and the main thread on Linux (X11 and Wayland, which need the system's development headers) and Windows; without audio, joysticks or IME libraries. Under Linux with D-Bus, for the file dialogs of the xdg-desktop-portal (SDL loads the system's libdbus at run time and needs only the headers to build); D-Bus is listed directly to switch off its default feature systemd, as with FreeType.
